THE_QUESTION: Did OG-PSP's paired specialist preservation produce complementary latent strategies that generalise to seeds never used for training, rehearsal, bank collection, or calibration?

WHY_EVAL_WAS_OPENED_DESPITE_A_PARTIAL_ME.ruling: PI, 2026-08-31: 'We prospectively declared the mechanism diagnostic not a gate. If we now refuse to open EVAL because z0 differentiation looks weak, we would quietly turn that diagnostic into the very gate we said it was not.'
WHY_EVAL_WAS_OPENED_DESPITE_A_PARTIAL_ME.state_at_authorization: Terminal checkpoint already frozen, no checkpoint selection occurred, CALIB did not modify the model, EVAL block untouched.
WHY_EVAL_WAS_OPENED_DESPITE_A_PARTIAL_ME.expectation_recorded_prospectively: The PI stated reduced confidence that both sides pass, given the asymmetric mechanism result, while ruling that confidence about a result is not a reason to withhold a frozen test. Recorded here so the expectation cannot be reconstructed after the fact.

MODEL_UNDER_TEST.periodic_checkpoints_ineligible: all 10, hashes recorded in the freeze record

CELLS.why_the_overlay_matters_here_too: Pole A is not plain OP6. Evaluating z0 against vanilla OP6 would score it against a different opponent than it trained on.

PRIMARY_GATE_CROSSOVER.metric: episode win indicator (blue_score > red_score), per evaluation seed
PRIMARY_GATE_CROSSOVER.statistic: paired percentile bootstrap over seed-level episode outcomes
PRIMARY_GATE_CROSSOVER.provenance: Identical to ORACLE_GATED_K2_EVAL_SPEC.json, which itself adopted the convention unchanged from eval_exp2_k2_terminal.py. Carried forward without modification so the criterion cannot be accused of having been chosen for this result. Point estimates alone do not pass the gate.

SECONDARY_REPORTED_NOT_GATED.status: REPORTED FOR CONTEXT ONLY. No retention bar was authorized for this experiment, so it does not gate the verdict and must not be introduced as a gate after the numbers are seen.
SECONDARY_REPORTED_NOT_GATED.per_cell_win_rates: all six cells reported with seed-level CIs

EPISODES_PER_CELL.note: one deterministic episode per (cell, seed); 32 seeds gives 32 paired observations per cell

ASYMMETRIC_OUTCOME_IS_PRE_CLASSIFIED.rule: PI, 2026-08-31, before the result existed: if delta_B passes but delta_A fails, the verdict is OG_PSP_CROSSOVER_NOT_CONFIRMED.
ASYMMETRIC_OUTCOME_IS_PRE_CLASSIFIED.why_this_is_stated_now: The mechanism diagnostic already showed the differentiation is one-sided, so a B-passes/A-fails outcome is the specifically foreseeable partial result. Pre-classifying it removes any room to argue after the fact that one passing side constitutes a confirmed crossover.
ASYMMETRIC_OUTCOME_IS_PRE_CLASSIFIED.richer_explanation_if_it_happens: OG-PSP successfully induced generalisable latent differentiation, but that differentiation emerged asymmetrically, primarily as a B-specialist rather than two complementary specialists.

INTERPRETIVE_CONTEXT_FROZEN_BEFORE_THE_R.budget: 1,003,520 terminal steps, identical to V1's. Unlike the V1-vs-EXP2C comparison there is no budget confound between V1 and OG-PSP.
INTERPRETIVE_CONTEXT_FROZEN_BEFORE_THE_R.two_axes: Paired supervision AND a 4.2x larger bank both change relative to V1, so a success cannot be attributed to either alone.

mechanism_diagnostic_result.summary: Latent divergence rose 6.39x on the matched held-out split and did not collapse, but the differentiation is one-sided: z1 is a B-specialist, z0 is not an A-specialist.
mechanism_diagnostic_result.status: context, not a gate; it does not predict or constrain this verdict

JSD_UNITS_CORRECTION_IS_PERMANENT.rule: PI, 2026-08-31: compare nats to nats across V1 and OG-PSP. Do not revive the model-vs-teacher percentage unless the teacher contrast is first converted into nats.
JSD_UNITS_CORRECTION_IS_PERMANENT.detail: _jsd_from_logits uses natural log, so all model JSD figures including V1's 0.0051 are NATS. diagnose_teacher_contrast.py used log2, so the 0.3919 teacher contrast is BITS. The earlier '1.3% of teacher contrast' divided one by the other.

PROHIBITED_AFTER_SEEING_EVAL: changing the metric, statistic, alpha, or criterion
adding seeds to the EVAL block
promoting retention or any secondary quantity into a gate
reporting point estimates as if they passed the frozen criterion
treating a single passing side as a confirmed crossover
IF_NEGATIVE: Recorded as OG_PSP_CROSSOVER_NOT_CONFIRMED. Under the stopping rule this is the FINAL latent attempt: a negative result closes latent-strategy work entirely and pivots immediately to the SAPPO-centered ICRA paper built around the compression-limit finding. No further latent experiments, no repair attempt, no additional seeds.
ONE_SHOT: EVAL is opened once. This spec is frozen and committed before it is read.

SUPERSEDES.why: That spec belonged to the bank-only V2 plan that OG-PSP superseded. It claims the same seed block but carries MODEL_UNDER_TEST: null and was never committed or run. Annotated as superseded rather than deleted.
